ruleset.name_en: Double-Champion v3.0 (Plan D) · Taleb B020_M125 + +8% Slow-Bear Latch + Dual-CTA CONT_2M
ruleset.name_zh: 双冠终极版 v3.0（Plan D）· 原汁正统 Taleb 满血核 + 改进 CTA 慢熊轮动 + +8% 磁滞锁存

core_overlay.rebalance_rule_en: NO daily 1.20x forced drawdown deleveraging cap (natural gross leverage drifts up to approx 1.26x during drawdowns so QQQ is NEVER liquidated at crash bottoms). Quarterly calm calibration restores 1.200x target.
core_overlay.rebalance_rule_zh: 取消每日 1.20x 强制去杠杆砍仓线（回撤期允许总杠杆自然漂移至约 1.26x，绝不在底部割肉 QQQ）；平稳无锁仓期按季校准回 1.200x。

sleeve_a.rule_en: Baseline Floor (0.20% NAV): Enter -15% OTM Put when VIX <= 20.0 AND VIX/VIX3M < 1.02 AND not in 5D Lockout. Normal regime: 125D -> Hard 75D roll/salvage. During +8% Slow-Bear Latch: NEVER open 125D — strictly open 90D -15% OTM and hold to Hard 30D salvage/roll.
sleeve_a.rule_zh: 常态底仓盾（0.20% NAV）：VIX <= 20.0 且 VIX/VIX3M < 1.02 且非 5 日锁仓期时买入 -15% OTM Put；常态买 125D -> 75D 强滚/回收残值；慢熊 +8% 锁存期内严禁开 125D，只能开 90D -15% OTM 且强行拿到 30DTE 收回残值/滚仓。

route1.rule_en: Standard Pillars (P1/P2/M3): Score = min(100, P1 + P2 + 10*M3 + 35*M4_latch). >= 35 -> 1 slot (1.25%), >= 45 -> 2 slots (2.50%), >= 65 -> 3 slots (3.75% NAV) in 125D -> Hard 75D roll (-15% OTM) outside Slow-Bear Latch; during +8% Slow-Bear Latch, ALL new puts strictly route to 90D -> Hard 30D roll.
route1.rule_zh: 标准危机三支柱（P1/P2/M3）：得分 = min(100, P1 + P2 + 10*M3 + 35*M4锁存)；>= 35 开 1 槽（1.25%）、>= 45 开 2 槽（2.50%）、>= 65 开满 3 槽（3.75% NAV）；门控 VXN <= 27.0 且 VIX/3M < 1.02；常态买 125D -> 75D 强滚，慢熊锁存期内一律切换为 90D -> 30D 强行收回（严禁开 125D）。

route2_m4.rule_en: User +8% Slow-Bear Hysteresis Latch (M4_latch_v2): ARM when QQQ < 200DMA & DD_252 <= -10.0% & Corr60(DualCTA, QQQ) < 0 & DualCTA gain >= +8.0%; RESET after 10 consecutive days QQQ > 200DMA. When ON & QQQ < 200DMA & EWMAC < 0 & QQQ > EMA20 & VXN <= 28.0 & VR <= 0.90 -> 90D -> Hard 30D roll, UNIFORM -15% OTM (1.25% NAV per slot).
route2_m4.rule_zh: 用户 +8% 慢熊磁滞锁存（M4_latch_v2）：QQQ < 200DMA 且 252日回撤 <= -10.0% 且 60日相关 < 0 且双CTA自高点涨 >= +8.0% 时锁存开启，连续 10 交易日站回 200DMA 解锁；开启且慢熊反弹（EWMAC < 0 & QQQ > EMA20 & VXN <= 28.0 & VR <= 0.90）时买 90D -> 30D 强滚，统一 -15% OTM（每槽 1.25% NAV）。

roll_economics.note_en: Hard 75D/30D roll recovers 67.1% weighted salvage on non-TP rolls, cutting 6.11% NAV/yr gross turnover down to only 2.04% NAV/yr true net roll bleed.
roll_economics.note_zh: 75D/30D 强制早滚仓在非止盈滚仓中平均回收 67.1% 残值，将名义流水 6.11% NAV/yr 压缩至仅 2.04% NAV/yr 的真实净损耗。

take_profit.rule_en: Full TP: (VIX/VIX3M >= 1.10 AND QQQ <= 1.05 x Strike [Near-ITM]) OR VIX >= 45.0 -> 100% liquidate. Late 5x TP: Remaining DTE <= 60D (Base) / <= 45D (Crisis) AND ROI >= 5.0x -> 100% liquidate. T+1 lump-sum 100% reinvestment into QQQ + 5D Post-TP Contango Lockout (VIX/VIX3M < 1.00 for 5 consecutive days) on BOTH books.
take_profit.rule_zh: 右尾全额止盈：（VIX/VIX3M >= 1.10 且 QQQ <= 1.05 倍行权价 [近实值]）或 VIX >= 45.0 -> 100% 清仓；晚段 5x 止盈：剩余到期 <= 60D（常态）/ <= 45D（危机）且回报 >= 5.0x -> 100% 清仓；T+1 一次性 100% 全额回买 QQQ，并对双账本启动止盈后 5 日正向期限结构锁仓（连续 5 日 VIX/3M < 1.00 解锁）。

cta_rotation.rule_en: User Improved Dual-CTA Rotation (CONT_2M): When QQQ stays DD_ATH <= -12.0% continuously for 60 calendar days AND per-ETF (DBMF / KMLM) return since QQQ ATH > 0%, rotate qualifying CTA sleeve into pure QQQ in 5 equal tranches spaced 5 trading days apart (cancel remaining if DD > -12.0%).
cta_rotation.rule_zh: 用户改进版双CTA慢熊轮动（CONT_2M）：QQQ 距前高连续 60 自然日 <= -12.0% 且单只 CTA（DBMF/KMLM）自前高涨幅 > 0% 时，分 5 批（每批间隔 5 交易日）切入 QQQ；若期间回撤收窄至 > -12.0% 则中止未执行批次。
cta_rotation.reload_rule_en: Mechanical 1-Year LTCG Restore: Each rotated QQQ tranche is mechanically held for 365 calendar days (US Long-Term Capital Gains compliance), then restored back to 10% DBMF + 10% KMLM (1.200x).
cta_rotation.reload_rule_zh: 365 天机械长期税率锁定恢复：每批切入的 QQQ 机械持有满 365 自然日（满足美股长期资本利得 LTCG），随后自动恢复为 10% DBMF + 10% KMLM（1.200x）。
